Upgrading to a new phone often comes with a hidden cost: if the new and old models differ in size, you'll need to buy a new protective case.

Users upgrading to the iPhone 18 Pro this year will almost inevitably need to purchase a new case—but two accessory makers have different takes on this, and one has made an even bolder prediction...

Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman posted a photo of an Otterbox case on Twitter, pointing out that the product is already listed at Best Buy and is compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom right corner of the packaging reads in English and French:

Compatible with iPhone 18 Pro iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself wasn't entirely convinced, adding: "It's still too early to draw conclusions." However, Matt Ronge, founder of Astropad—which primarily produces anti-glare screen protectors for iPhones—said his suppliers told him the same thing.

iPhone Pro thickness remains a subject of debate

Last year, a leaker claimed the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. The report didn't mention the smaller Pro model, but sources within the iPhone supply chain indicated the iPhone 18 Pro would be two millimeters thicker than the previous generation.

This trend appears to be continuing, as both iPhone 17 Pro models are thicker and heavier than their predecessors.

Not all leakers agree though—some claim the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be exactly the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's take

Apple does sometimes provide case manufacturers with dimensions in advance so that third-party cases can launch alongside new iPhones. On the other hand, accessory makers sometimes simply place orders based on rumors, which may not be accurate. Personally, I wouldn't buy a case before a new iPhone is officially announced.
